title: Confirm sets bins to zero and saves untracked, Cancel undoes the change
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. A tracked part holding more than zero, and a tracked part holding zero.
custom_steps:
1. Turn tracking off on the stock-holding part and confirm; check every bin quantity and the tracking state.
  2. Repeat but Cancel; check the toggle and the part.
  3. Turn tracking off on the zero-stock part and observe whether a confirmation appears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On confirmation every bin quantity is set to zero and the part is saved as untracked; on cancel the toggle returns to on and nothing about the part is changed.
  • Turning tracking off on a part holding zero shows no confirmation and the toggle changes straight away.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 5 (Edit tracking state); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E5: “On confirmation, every bin quantity for that part is set to zero.”
  • S5-E6: “On confirmation, the part is saved as untracked.”
  • S5-E7: “If the user cancels, the toggle returns to on.”
  • S5-E8: “If the user cancels, nothing about the part is changed.”
  • S5-E9: “If the user turns tracking off on a part holding zero, no confirmation appears and the toggle changes straight away.”
